changelog: 5.9.24 (Build 5924): Meet the new Ruby AI - rebuilt assistant powered by Google Gemini with Pro, Coding and Image modes, study flashcards, code highlighting and a polished ruby color scheme. Paste your free Gemini API key once using the API Key button inside Ruby AI - it is saved on your device only.
Includes everything from 5.9.23: movable weather widget, the 1-minute update check screen with update counter, and the red roadblock screen with automatic fallback to your last working version.
